title: 第1章 重生帝辛慌得一比第2章 人族圣母你也配
slug: 重生商纣开局怒怼圣人女娲
content_zh:
第1章重生帝辛，慌得一比！纣王七年，
春，
三月十八！
“嘶……疼疼疼，脑阔疼！”
在一间古香古色的房间内，一名魁梧男子忽然抱头喊痛，紧接着，一股庞大的记忆忽然涌入他的脑海中。
床上的男子顿时如遭雷击，整个人如同木雕般愣在那里！
那股剧痛来得快，去得更快，可是床上男子的脸，却已经黑成了锅底！
“啥子情况？我特么穿越了成了帝辛？不对，绝对不对，我肯定是在做梦！”
魁梧男子脸上带着深深的难以置信，随后又装作无事地躺在床上。
他想快点醒来，继续投入‘996福报’之中！
“大王、大王，该上早朝了！”
就在这时，一道带着焦急却又小心翼翼的声音，忽然在男子耳边响起，瞬间惊扰了他的美梦！
我特么真穿越了？
帝辛猛地睁开满是悲伤的眼睛，默默流泪！
不过刚来到这个世界，他不敢太过张扬，同时也在回想着记忆中，有关帝辛的一切。
很快，
帝辛眼中再度流下了悲伤的泪水……
穿越成谁不好，偏偏穿越成这个，被人黑到无力反驳的末代人皇身上？
要说帝辛一生也是悲催，他这一生都在算计和被利用之中！
五天前，

准提用‘七情六欲气’污染了帝辛，
紧接着三天前，帝辛祭女娲庙的时候，西方那俩货又遮掩天机，让帝辛看到了女娲真容。
随后这货脑瓜子一热，即兴题诗一首，就把自己推入了万丈深渊！
甚至在后来，连带整个洪荒人族都被他坑了！
这也导致了洪荒时期，本来是‘天、地、人’三道并立的局面，变成了地道和人道融入天道，而使得天道超然物外，凌驾一切之上的结局！
而这一切，
就是从那首诗开始！
至于现在？
却是因为准提弄的‘七情六欲气’的量有点大，再加上见了女娲真容之后，帝辛就有点上头，
好好的一个大老爷们，愣是被相思苦给折磨死了，
这才让来自蓝星的他附身了！
这时，帝辛黑着脸，恨恨地骂道：“玛德，要是早来三天就好了，老子就能扭转历史了，可特么现在一切都成定局了，老子该肿麽办？”
content_en:
Chapter 1 The reborn Emperor Xin was so panicked! In the seventh year of King Zhou,
spring,
March 18th!
"Hiss...it hurts, it hurts, my brain hurts!"
In an antique room, a burly man suddenly held his head and cried out in pain. Then, a huge memory suddenly poured into his mind.
The man on the bed suddenly felt as if he had been struck by lightning, and he stood there as stunned as a wooden sculpture!
The sharp pain came and went even faster, but the face of the man on the bed was already as black as the bottom of the pot!
"What's going on? Did I travel through time and become Di Xin? No, absolutely not, I must be dreaming!"
The burly man had a look of deep disbelief on his face, and then he lay down on the bed pretending to be nothing.
He wants to wake up quickly and continue to devote himself to the '996 Blessings'!
"Your Majesty, Your Majesty, it's time to go to the morning court!"
At this moment, an anxious but cautious voice suddenly sounded in the man's ears, instantly disturbing his sweet dream!
Did I really travel through time?
Di Xin suddenly opened his eyes full of sadness and cried silently!
But when he first came to this world, he didn't dare to be too showy. At the same time, he was also recalling everything about Di Xin in his memory.
Soon,
Di Xin shed tears of sadness again...
Who would it be bad to travel through time, but to be like this, the last human emperor who was hacked to the point of being unable to refute?
To say that Di Xin's life was miserable, he was being plotted and exploited all his life!
five days ago,
Zhunti used the "seven emotions and six desires" to pollute Emperor Xin,
Three days ago, when Di Xin was offering sacrifices to Nu Wa in the temple, those two guys from the West concealed the secret again, allowing Di Xin to see Nu Wa's true appearance.
Then this guy got excited, composed an impromptu poem, and pushed himself into the abyss!
Even later, the entire prehistoric human race was tricked by him!
This also led to the situation in the prehistoric period where the three realms of "heaven, earth, and man" were originally coexisting. It became an ending where the earth and humanity merged into the heaven, making the heaven transcendent and superior to everything else!
And all this,
It started with that poem!
As for now?
But it was because the amount of the 'Seven Emotions and Six Desires' produced by Zhunti was a bit large, and after seeing Nuwa's true appearance, Di Xin became a little over the top.
A good old man, but he was tortured to death by lovesickness.
Only then did he from Blue Star become possessed!
At this time, Di Xin had a dark face and cursed bitterly: "Madeh, if I had come three days earlier, I would have been able to reverse history, but now everything is a foregone conclusion, what should I do?"
